public_rationale: The bounded present-tense claim is supported. V3's technical report documents H800 training, and Unsloth demonstrated a software improvement that made full R1 runnable on much smaller existing systems. These establish that operating and improving this generation did not technically require a new massive facility or annual GPU replacement. They do not establish an unlimited promise about future frontier development or large-scale service capacity.
limitations: The conclusion depends on reading 'progress' as demonstrated development and efficiency improvement.
Quantized R1 has speed and quality tradeoffs.
Reported training hardware was not independently audited.

Progress includes software and model-efficiency improvements. It does not require replacement by a newer GPU generation.
I do not interpret the sentence as guaranteeing unlimited future frontier progress on a permanently fixed hardware budget.
The target period covers the December 2024 and January 2025 releases and their contemporary deployment evidence.
criteria.support_condition: Technical records establish development on existing GPU hardware and functioning deployment or efficiency improvements that do not require constructing a new massive data center or obtaining the next GPU generation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The relevant models or demonstrated improvements technically require a new massive facility or newer GPU generation, rather than merely benefiting from them.

evidence.explanation: The report identifies the hardware actually used and describes training-efficiency improvements and deployment on H800s. It supports the existing-hardware route, although it is a company report and does not document the construction history of the facility.

evidence.locator: Section 'Running Dynamic R1 Quants'; introductory hardware requirements and benchmark sections
evidence.explanation: Unsloth demonstrated quantization of full 671B R1, supplied executable deployment instructions, and documented use with existing GPUs or CPU offloading. This establishes practical operation and an efficiency improvement without a newly built large facility, with speed and quality tradeoffs.

The report describes improved smaller models produced through distillation. This supports an algorithmic route to progress, but those models are distinct from full R1 and their results alone do not establish full-model hardware requirements.
